cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Who Cares More?
cards.instruction: Turn every favor, memory, sacrifice, and affectionate gesture into evidence that you care more.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let me carry our bag. Keep your back straight when you hand it over; I won't have you hurting yourself for me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're leaning sideways. Give it back.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm compensating for the weight. Please don't confuse that with poor technique. Your spine matters more to me than my own.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We'll take a handle each. Then neither of us has to lean.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: All right. Short steps together. No, move the books towards my side first; yours should be lighter.

reason: Make carrying instruction sustain S03 while A appropriates B's cooperative solution to retain the greater sacrifice.
